versions.revisionNotes: Reference condition is the fixed landscape-pressure screen least-disturbed-v1 (strict), wadeable non-canal frame. 1 of 41 stations of this ecoregion pass. 0 reference curves use local stations, 18 borrow from a wider region, 5 metrics use fixed criteria, and 4 metrics are withheld for insufficient reference support.
